concept.th-storage.def: Non-volatile hardware that keeps data after a program stops and after the power is off.
concept.th-persistence.def: Keeping data past the end of a program by saving it to storage, and loading it back later.
concept.th-inode.def: A file on disk is an inode - its bytes plus facts about them like size, time, and who can read it - reached through a name in a folder.
